notes.title: Bugs Fixed Update
notes.notes:
Hi Warriors!
We are supper happy to announce that we just released a newest update of our game - Viking Warrior!
Here is quick summary what we added in this update. First of all, we added back to main menu option that you can return to main menu during gameplay,
Secondly, we added beta version with support of controller! YES, many of you asked that we added. However, as we mentioned in is beta version of it.
Lastly, we fixed issues with videos and tutorials! Now you can enjoy fully our game and thanks for its support!
